P.name: Battle Fury
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Tryndamere''' generates {{tip|fury|{{as|5 Fury}}}} on his {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}}, and {{as|10 Fury}} on {{tip|critical strikes}} and each time he kills an enemy. After 8 seconds without dealing or taking damage, '''Tryndamere''' loses {{as|5 Fury}} per second.
P.description2: '''Tryndamere''' gains {{sti|critical strike chance|{{as|{{pp|0 to 50|key=%|0 to 100 by 5|type=Fury|color=Fury|label=Crit chance}} critical strike chance}}}}.

Q.name: Bloodlust
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Tryndamere''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} based on his {{as|'''missing''' health}}, up to a maximum amount at {{as|90% '''missing''' health}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Maximum Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|20 to 80}}|Bonus Attack Damage per 1% missing health|{{ap|{{#expr:{{#var:h1}} round 2}} to {{#expr:{{#var:h5}} round 2}}}}}}
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tryndamere''' consumes all of his {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}} to {{tip|heal}} himself, increased for every point of {{as|Fury}} consumed.

W.name: Mocking Shout
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tryndamere''' reduces the {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} of nearby enemy champions for 4 seconds.
W.description2: '''Tryndamere''' also applies a curse to all nearby enemy champions for {{fd|3.25}} seconds. While accursed, they become {{tip|slow|slowed}} while facing away from '''Tryndamere'''.
W.description3: ''A nearby enemy champion is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be targeted by this ability.''

E.name: Spinning Slash
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tryndamere''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and generating {{tip|fury|{{as|2 Fury}}}} per enemy hit, increased to {{as|5 Fury}} against champions.
E.description2: {{tip|Critical strikes}} {{tip|on-hit}} reduce ''Spinning Slash's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{fd|0.75}} seconds, doubled to {{fd|1.5}} seconds against {{tip|champions}}.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Bloodlust|Tryndamere}} and {{ai|Undying Rage|Tryndamere}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Undying Rage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tryndamere''' becomes enraged, instantly gaining {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}} and a {{tip|minimum health threshold}} for 5 seconds.
R.description2: ''Undying Rage can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
